mapper.update: UPDATE laundry_session SET status=#{session.status},completed_at=#{session.completedAt}, risk_active=#{session.riskActive},risk_cycle=#{session.riskCycle},version=#{session.version} WHERE id=#{session.id} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_snapshot(id,location,source,observed_at,valid_until,available,raining,rain_probability,reason) VALUES(1,#{location},#{source},#{observedAt},#{validUntil},#{available},#{raining},#{rainProbability},#{reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE location=VALUES(location),source=VALUES(source),observed_at=VALUES(observed_at),valid_until=VALUES(valid_until), available=VALUES(available),raining=VALUES(raining),rain_probability=VALUES(rain_probability),reason=VALUES(reason)
